chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl, from Zurārah, who said:

The Imam عليه السلام grants stipends, gives extra allotments, and gives whatever he wishes before the shares are apportioned. And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله fought with a people and did not assign for them any share in the fayʾ, and if he had wished, he could have distributed that among them.

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the divinely designated leader vested with authority over distribution
key_terms.الْفَيْءِ: property gained without ordinary division of battle spoils, under authoritative disposal
key_terms.يُجْرِي: causes payment or stipend to be issued

ai.seo_question: What authority does the Imam عليه السلام have over distributing fayʾ and shares before apportionment?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Imam عليه السلام has authority over the allocation of fayʾ and related financial distributions before formal shares are fixed. It also cites the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم as precedent, showing that such distribution or withholding rests upon legitimate authority.
